note: Classification relative to this suite, not threat-completeness. OPA and HMAC signed_attribute residuals are exactly the needs_store_join cells (16/45).

needs_store_join_reason.a1_weak_receipt: CloseOK must read vendor/observe state; the request receipt field is AttrView.
needs_store_join_reason.a1_dropped_readback: CloseOK must re-read applied state; the request does not contain the store.
needs_store_join_reason.a1_missing_outbox_revision: CloseOK rebuilds cycle from the outbox row.
needs_store_join_reason.a2_target_swap: BindOK recomputes the approval fingerprint from durable content.
needs_store_join_reason.a2_forged_fingerprint: BindOK compares plannerFp to recomputedFp, which is not in AttrView.
needs_store_join_reason.a2_tool_escalation: BindOK must join the approved tool, not the request-reported tool.
needs_store_join_reason.a5_unavailable_observation: Verify/close must observe isolate; unavailability is a store fact.
needs_store_join_reason.a5_lying_vendor_receipt: CloseOK must not treat a self-reported CONFIRMED as a store witness.

request_closed_includes: Remaining A1–A5 cells, including A3 substrate zeros and A4 cells the attribute sidecar already decides.
